query:
SELECT avatar, did, display_name, handle
            FROM profiles
            WHERE display_name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' ESCAPE '!'
               OR description ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' ESCAPE '!'
               OR handle ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' ESCAPE '!'
            ORDER BY display_name NULLS LAST, did
            LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
